10314006.en: Immortal! Your grace and bearing are truly unmatched! Every time I see you, I'm struck anew by your extraordinary presence!

10314007.en: Your magnificence and selflessness leave this humble one in complete awe. Under your leadership, our future shall surely grow ever brighter and more glorious!

10314008.en: From now on, simply call for me whenever you visit, and I shall provide you with the most devoted service. Allow me to guide you to where those vile Nether Beasts dwell.

10314009.en: Oh! Just think of our Pavilion Master's great accomplishments, benefiting all the realms by studying the legacy arts of past master cultivators to strengthen us!

10314010.en: Yet how pathetic that the cultivators of the realms are nothing but worthless clay! They were stopped by mere Nether Beasts and fell to such a miserable state—truly a pitiful sight indeed!

10314011.en: Oh, my Immortal! Our Pavilion has received word of your world-shaking might! Those little Nether Beasts were completely annihilated by you! What an incredible deed! If only I could possess even a fraction of your grace, my life would be complete!

10314012.en: She concludes her words with two claps, and a servant emerges from behind, head bowed, carrying something in his hands...

10314013.en: Look here, Immortal! This is the Enigmatic Stone our Pavilion presents to you. We'll be selling our remaining Enigmatic Stones in the Elixir section soon. Do remember to call for me when you come shopping! I shall take my leave now!

10314014.en: Welcome, Immortal! Right this way, please! The Enigmatic Stones from Chi You can no longer be produced. Once used, they'll be gone. Please use them wisely!

10314015.en: (The Nether Beasts in this area have been eliminated. Time to head back!)

10314016.en: These are the remains of a cultivator corrupted by Nether Air. The wounds on the body suggest they were perhaps engaged in fierce combat with other human beings before meeting this tragic end.

10314017.en: Scattered around are pages made of an unusual material. More than half are illegible, damaged by water dripping from the cave ceiling. Among the readable pages, only the surname "You" can be made out from the signature. The remaining text contains some descriptions of the Enigmatic Stone...

10314018.en: Oh? What brings you to call upon me, Immortal? Are you here about the Enigmatic Stones? Chi You can no longer produce any Enigmatic Stones these days; please use what you have wisely! I am quite busy at the moment and cannot attend to you personally, so please do as you will!

10314019.en: Before even finishes speaking, she leisurely settles into a lounge chair and begins eating fruit as if you don't exist.

10314101.en:
When the world formed, the ley lines served to separate Nether Air from Qi. The Nether Air continuously erodes these lines, attempting to break through to the surface.
After eons of enduring invasions, the ley lines developed their own defense mechanisms, with the Enigmatic Stones being the key to their protection.
The Enigmatic Stones themselves have also developed self-preservation abilities by keeping forming crystalline structures to seal and protect themselves from exposure.

10314102.en:
Furthermore, Enigmatic Stones can generate spirits to protect themselves against intruders.
Since ancient times, countless cultivators have ventured here for Enigmatic Stones. In response, the stones manifest their spirits to repel these visitors while also acquiring their Martial Arts and Spiritual Skills in the process.
The exact mechanism behind this remains unknown and requires further investigation.

10441317.en: Uh... do you actually think theft is some kind of game?

10441318.en: Hah! I won't be your child or your parent, and I certainly won't be your sibling!

10441319.en: Yes! Let's explore all the mystic realms together!

10441320.en: I... I will be your Partner... but you—you must never betray me!

10441321.en: No way, a master-disciple relationship would be too weird for us!

10441322.en: That place is so boring! How about I find somewhere more exciting, and we go there instead?

10441324.en: Sure, but watch out! I've been diligently cultivating even during my time back home!

10441325.en: I still hate these cultivation debates—they're so boring!

10441326.en: Thank heavens, I've finally returned to the world.

10441327.en: My experiences in the world have taught me to cherish what I have—my royal father, my friends, and you...

10441328.en: I feared I'd return to find the world completely transformed, but thankfully, everything is still here—and so are you.

10441329.en: They say joy and sorrow always come hand in hand. Like that day when I left—your plea for my return filled me with boundless happiness, yet our parting plunged me into the depths of sorrow and despair.

10441330.en: My royal father once said that life is about finding something worth fighting for with all your might. After leaving the world, I realized I'd found exactly what I'd give everything to protect.

10441331.en: I've always let the beauty around me slip away without realizing it. This time, I'll cherish and treasure everything important with all my heart.

10441332.en: If you find anything I have useful, feel free to take it.

10441333.en: No need for thanks between us, but I'm still really happy about your gift.

10441334.en: How could you bear to leave a delicate flower like me to wither away in that lifeless sect?

10441335.en: No need for thanks between us, but I'm still really happy about your gift.

10442452.en: The dwelling of your old friend has clearly been neglected for some time. Sunlight streams in, revealing dust motes dancing in the air. Cobwebs blanket the surroundings, and a faint scent of wood lingers in the air.

10442453.en: Suddenly, a flash of cyan catches your eye. As you turn, you see a tall, elegant woman looking back at you. Her expression shifts rapidly from startled to one of delighted recognition.

10442455.en: Hehe, didn't I tell you? I said I'd come back, and here I am—promise kept, my friend!

10442456.en: After her cheerful greeting, Ao Yao lifts her gaze to the sky. The clouds have parted, revealing a pristine azure expanse without a trace of shadow.

10442457.en: You arrive at Ao Yao's former dwelling and, to your surprise, you find a letter left behind.

10442458.en: Mm, I've always been on my own... I've longed for someone I could call a sister.

10442459.en: Yes, yes! Let's become sworn sisters! But let me make one thing clear—there's no age order between us. I'll be both your Younger Sister and your Older Sister!

10442460.en: Oh my, I actually wanted to suggest becoming sworn sisters too, but you just beat me to it. Alright! As your Older Sister, I'll always take good care of you, dear little one.

10442461.en: Yes! But... what's this about becoming sworn sisters? Oh, I get it! Just like how men and women become spouses, women who share a deep bond become sworn sisters! That's what we are—sisters!

10442462.en: I've always been aloof to everything, but you are different. Let's set aside formalities—from this day forward, we are sworn sisters.

10442463.en: Have you come to visit me?

10442464.en: Oh? What would you like to learn? Don't hesitate to ask any questions—I will teach you everything I know.

10442465.en: I lead quite a dull life up here in the mountains. Besides reading, there isn't much to do... Do come visit me when you can.

10442468.en: {name|B} walks beside you, generously sharing her knowledge of the Manual. As she turns occasionally, her elegant hair catches the wind, sending gentle wafts of fragrance your way.

10442469.en: {name|B} notices immediately and turns to look at you, momentarily surprised. But her composure returns in an instant. With a gentle smile, she leans close to your ear and whispers the remaining knowledge. Only after sharing everything does she ask with a playful grin.

10442470.en: Was I speaking too softly? Could you hear me clearly?

10442471.en: Hah. How would you like me to demonstrate it for you?

10442472.en: Hearing your words, {name|B} smiles softly and moves closer. The distance between you shrinks until you can feel each other's breath. Her lips part in a playful smile as she slowly says...

10442474.en: Just as she's about to leave, she suddenly reaches out and presses her palms against yours. As your hands intertwine, energy flows between you, coursing through each other's bodies in waves of tingling sensations.

10442475.en: As the energy flows between you, your vital essence slowly merges with {name|B}'s until they become one. Suddenly, a loud crash—the bookshelves, unable to withstand the surge of your combined energy, topple over. Countless scrolls and books rain down upon your head, and moments later, everything fades to black.

10442476.en: When you open your eyes again, you feel an inexplicable vitality coursing through your body, brimming with energy. You look over to find {name|B} quietly reading in the corner—the bookshelves stand perfectly intact, with every scroll meticulously arranged. You can't help but wonder: was everything that just happened... real?

10442477.en: I absolutely adore such a diligent student—you're just my type! That's all for today's lesson. If there's anything else you don't understand, feel free to come to me again.

10442478.en: {name|B} looks you over with amusement, then playfully flicks your cheek. With a gentle smile, she turns and heads back inside to continue her reading.

10442479.en: Very good! I love clever and obedient ones like you. Class dismissed for today, my dear student. If there's anything else you don't understand, feel free to come to me again.

10442480.en: {name|B} looks you over with amusement, then playfully flicks your cheek. With a gentle smile, she turns and heads back inside to continue her reading.

10442481.en: Very good! I love obedient ones like you. Class dismissed for today, my dear student. If there's anything else about cultivation you don't understand, feel free to come to me again.

10442482.en: {name|B} looks you over with amusement, then playfully flicks your cheek. With a gentle smile, she turns and heads back inside to continue her reading.

10442484.en: Hey there! Have you been missing me? I had a sudden insight while studying some secret manuscripts the other day, so I wrote it all down. Thought it might be useful for you, so here you go.

10442485.en: {name|B} suddenly leans in close, whispering in your ear.

10442486.en: Not only am I not slowing down your cultivation, I've even brought you a manual. So tell me, how do you plan to repay me in the future?

10442487.en: With these playful words, she suddenly vanishes into thin air, disappearing in a wisp of smoke.

10442488.en: Did you come to my place just to space out? We can't waste such precious time! Here, take this manual—and make sure you study it properly.

10442491.en: No, show me how it's done

10442495.en: I, the princess, am tired of sitting around—I want to go out on an adventure!

10442496.en: Oh? You're the one who suggested it! You can't say I forced you into this! Hehe, I'll go on ahead—you better keep up!

10442497.en: Hurry, hurry! What do you think we'll find in there? Murderous ghosts? Sights we've never seen before? I can't wait!

10442498.en: Suddenly, monsters spring forth from every corner of the Mystic Realm, completely surrounding you.

10442499.en: Ugh, I just don't get it! Why do Mystic Realms always have to be full of monsters? Can't they give us a break for once?

10442500.en: After defeating the creatures in the Mystic Realm, Ao Yao gleefully searches for treasures and hands them to you with a bright smile.

10442501.en: Thanks for spending time with me! You... you'll come play with me more often, won't you? It's no fun playing alone!

10442502.en: You follow {name|B} into the Mystic Realm, bracing for monster attacks, but instead find yourself stunned by an unexpected vista—an expanse where boundless ocean meets infinite sky.

10442503.en: It should be safe here. Oh? It's... it's the ocean... Would you... would you come explore underwater with me?

10442504.en: With your consent, {name|B} gives you a warm smile, takes your hand, and swiftly pulls you beneath the waves.

10442505.en: As you dive into the deep, your breath becomes labored, forcing you to breathe through the pores of your body. But as {name|B} leads you deeper, the crushing pressure becomes increasingly unbearable.

10442506.en: As you dive deeper, {name|B} frequently looks back to check on your condition. Despite your best efforts to endure, the pressure inside your body continues to build, and your energy grows increasingly chaotic.
